subject: GitHub-style Markdown alerts use five theme-aware semantic color roles and readable body typography

method.browser: Actual Google Chrome executable, isolated owned verification profiles
method.application: Real standalone Agent Canvas, actual Agent Server/SDK1.56.0, automation1.22.0, exact checked-in pins; no mocked/intercepted responses or localStorage seeding
method.model: deepseek/deepseek-flash via Keychain credential, never included in evidence
method.fileArrangement: Same fixture copied into each owned real workspace after CLI fixture file; Files refreshed and opened normally. Arrangement is a precondition, not proof of UI file creation. Files is read-only.
method.themes: Selected via actual Settings / App theme combobox
method.measurement: Read-only getComputedStyle and ancestor alpha compositing; OffscreenCanvas converts computed colors to sRGB; WCAG relative luminance on actual host surfaces, including one nested Warning and compiled Files prose descendants
method.phoneFiles: Actual Hide file tree control used for matched full-width phone captures in both phases; desktop keeps tree visible. Pointer moved to blank top-left via actual mouse click to dismiss timestamp hover overlays.
method.geometry: All20 matched cases preserve type/nesting, width/height within1CSSpx; no After document horizontal overflow.

superseded.reason: Initial capture pass lacked complete typography measurements and showed timestamp hover overlay in one chat shot. Final phone Files shots hide the actual file tree for legibility in both phases; older narrow shots kept locally and excluded from selected set.

limits: Live proof covers real standalone Local conversations, user/assistant Markdown and Files rich preview, all5 built-in themes, desktop/phone, one level of nested alert. Shared renderer consumers and library embedding are covered by code/focused tests; no authenticated Cloud, ACP or arbitrary host-palette visual pass is claimed.

No universal claim for arbitrary nesting depth or syntax-token colors. Existing icons, labels, parsing and ordinary blockquote styling are preserved; the migration adjusts alert ink/tint and scoped prose descendants.

Raw model-entry recordings include normal model wait time. After Files video idle trimming yielded4.3seconds from73.6seconds wall time; clean screenshots prove the final matching states. Edited film must use actual clips/screenshots without fabricating UI.

privacyReview.notes: No secrets in selected UI. Chrome profiles, settings/LLM profiles, raw private state and Keychain reads are excluded.
